property_summary: After any successful call to initialize(_baseToken, ...), the pool's baseToken state variable must equal the _baseToken argument passed in; the mutant skips the assignment so c.baseToken() remains address(0) for any non-zero _baseToken.

For every admissible input, initialize must set the public baseToken getter exactly to the _baseToken argument (the base token used for payments); the mutant sets baseToken to the _nft argument instead, so whenever _baseToken != _nft the invariant c.baseToken() == _baseToken is broken.

After any successful initialize call, c.baseToken() must equal the _baseToken argument supplied by the caller; the mutant always stores address(0), breaking this whenever a nonzero base token is passed.

After any successful initialize, the pool's flash-loan fee token (returned by the public flashFeeToken view) must equal the _baseToken argument supplied; the mutant always stores address(0), so flashFeeToken() returns address(0) for any nonzero base token.

For any admissible initialization, the pool's stored NFT address must equal the _nft parameter passed to initialize; the mutant stores _baseToken instead, so any call with _nft != _baseToken violates this invariant.
